about: US / Canada parks that still have something empty: no outline, or at least one column still missing. Parks with every column filled are counted in scoreboard.json only. Facts only; built nightly by .github/scripts/kpc_scoreboard_bot.py (column logic in its docstring). status / near_miss on missing-outline rows are chat 8's gap fields (no layer / likely name mismatch), kept as they were.

keys._: a key left out means 0 / empty / unknown / n (per: ?, sz: unknown, fer: n, camp: n)
keys.o: outline: off official | pad PAD-US | osm OpenStreetMap (unofficial) | pin pin-only | line | miss missing
keys.map: official map: 0 missing, 1 have, 2 have + dated
keys.camp: campground: h have, n none found, - not applicable
keys.fer: 2-fer passes: y yes, n no, p partial
keys.miss: columns still empty, one letter each: o outline, m official map, r rules, h hours, f fees, a access point, w who runs, c closures source (state), s size check, k campground
